# task\-cli\-list\-option\-absorption — CLI list\-valued options must not absorb the following option token
status: todo  priority: 1  scope: scope-cli
readiness: not_eligible  reason: status_todo

Fix an input\-layer defect that lets a list\-valued option swallow the following option token\. With Commander 15, \`\.option\("\-\-depends\-on \<id\.\.\.\>"\)\` given no values of its own captures the next option name and its values as its own: \`task create x \-\-title T \-\-depends\-on \-\-description desc \-\-json\` parses to dependencies \["\-\-description","desc"\]\. When the captured token fails the record\-id rule the whole create is rejected with a misleading "must be filesystem\-safe" message, and when it passes the free\-text rule the wrong value is written silently with exit status 0: \`task create q \-\-title Q \-\-acceptance \-\-json\` created a record whose acceptance list is \["\-\-json"\], and \`task update p4 \-\-path\-hint \-\-json\` replaced that record's path hints with \["\-\-json"\]\. Guard the CLI input layer so a list\-valued flag can never consume an option\-looking token, report a value\-less flag as such, keep space\-separated multi\-value usage working, and give update commands an explicit spelling for clearing a list\.

## Acceptance
- Every list\-valued flag on every mutating command \(task create/update, issue create/update, message, handoff\) refuses an option\-looking token with a coded diagnostic naming the flag, a nonzero exit status and no record written; the four observed shapes become regression tests\.
- The silent variant is asserted at record level: after a refused call the record's acceptance, path hints, dependencies and prompts are byte\-identical to before\.
- Legitimate usage still works: space\-separated multi\-value \(\-\-depends\-on a b c\) and a repeated flag both accumulate, and each update command has a documented explicit way to clear a list, shown in \-\-help\.
- A list option given no values reports that it requires at least one value, never a schema message about filesystem safety\.
- The guard is one shared CLI helper with no core schema change, and bun test, typecheck and validate \-\-project \-\-views all pass\.
